english.title: Fail to pay fare for a journey and fail to give / give false name and address to an authorised person

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) used a specified service namely

(A)_[the Tyne and Wear Metro]_
(B)_[a public service vehicle operated under the Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979]_

and having failed to pay

(C)_[the fare for the journey you were making, namely **(..SPECIFY THE JOURNEY FROM AND TO..),]_
(D)_[the fare for the additional distance of the journey you were making, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ADDITION JOURNEY FROM AND TO..),]_

after having been requested to provide your name and address by an authorised person as specified in the Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979, without reasonable excuse

(E)_[failed to give your name and address]_
(F)_[gave a false name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(4)(c) of the Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979.

english.notes:
(i) Section 5(1) of the Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979 provides that this offence applies on and after the appointed day to persons using specified services, that is to say, persons making a journey on the Metro or on a public service vehicle operated by or, subject to section 8 of this Act, on behalf of the Executive on an area bus service in the designated area, or partly on the Metro and partly on such a public service vehicle.
(ii) Section 5(6) of the Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979 provides that liability to punishment for an offence under this section shall not prejudice the recovery of any fare payable by the offender.
(iii) Section 5(7) of the Tyne and Wear Passenger Transport Act 1979 provides that section 5 of the Regulation of Railways Act 1889 (penalty for avoidance of payment of fare) and regulation 11 of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1936 (and any statutory provision amending or replacing that regulation) shall not apply to persons using specified services.

other.powersofarrest:
arrest without warrant

Section 6 of the Tyne and wear Passenger Transport Act 1979 provides that If a constable suspects with reasonable cause that a person has contravened section 5 (Avoidance of Fare) of this Act, the constable may require the person to give his name and address to the constable; and if the person refuses to give their name and address to the constable or gives a name and address to the constable but does not answer to the satisfaction of the constable questions put to him by the constable for the purpose of ascertaining whether the name and address are correct, the constable may arrest him without warrant.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding five hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
